train_sentence_transformer_gaudi: train a SentenceTransformer model on Intel Gaudi HPU using SentenceTransformerGaudiTrainer with Habana framework
create_gaudi_trainer_with_loss: create a SentenceTransformerGaudiTrainer with a custom loss function like CoSENTLoss for sentence embedding training
evaluate_sentence_transformer_gaudi: evaluate a trained SentenceTransformer model using SentenceTransformerGaudiTrainer with a custom SentenceEvaluator
configure_multi_dataset_batch_sampler: configure a multi-dataset batch sampler using RoundRobinBatchSampler or ProportionalBatchSampler for training on multiple datasets
save_load_sentence_transformer_checkpoin: save and load a SentenceTransformer model checkpoint using SentenceTransformerGaudiTrainer save and load methods
